_commentaire: FAQ knowledge base (English). This file is editable WITHOUT touching the code. Add/edit entries and the assistant will use them on next startup. Each entry has 'mots_cles' (keywords) that help find the right answer.

entrees.question: What are your customer service hours?
entrees.reponse: Our customer service team is available Monday to Saturday, from 8 AM to 8 PM. Our automated assistant is available 24/7.

entrees.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
entrees.reponse: We deliver everywhere in Senegal. Delivery is faster in Dakar and its suburbs, and we also cover all regions across the country.

entrees.question: How long does delivery take?
entrees.reponse: On average, delivery takes 2 to 5 business days in Dakar and 3 to 7 business days in the rest of Senegal.

entrees.question: What is your return policy?
entrees.reponse: You may return an item within 14 days of receiving it, provided it is unused and in its original packaging. Refunds are processed after verification.

entrees.question: How much does delivery cost?
entrees.reponse: Delivery fees in Dakar are 2,000 FCFA. For other regions, fees range from 3,000 to 5,000 FCFA depending on the destination. Delivery is free for orders over 50,000 FCFA.

entrees.question: What payment methods do you accept?
entrees.reponse: We accept cash on delivery, Orange Money, Wave, and bank card payments.

entrees.question: How can I track my order?
entrees.reponse: To track your order, provide your order number (e.g. CMD-1001) along with your phone number or email address for identity verification. Our assistant will give you the real-time status.

entrees.question: My package arrived damaged. What should I do?
entrees.reponse: We are sorry to hear that. Please contact us immediately with your order number and a photo of the damage. We will open a complaint ticket and resolve the issue within 48 hours.
